PROBLEM: Amendment section 5 and acceptance 8-9 want a command-driven Specialist inspector that opens a native transcript or feed overlay reusing the sp-terminal-overlay UX over the native AgentSession, with no legacy sp feed subprocess for native sessions. The operator deliberately deferred this: the ui.custom path hard-locks the TUI in this pi version even after the flicker fix (unitAI-z49s2) and the string-row fix (unitAI-dygdq), so unitAI-nmxhg removed the inspector mount and /fleet inspect prints a text report instead.

SCOPE (rough): TBD after pi ui.custom reliability is proven. Likely the openFleetInspector path in config/pi-extensions/specialist-subagents/index.mjs plus an overlay component consuming host inspect transcript and events, plus tests. Needs exploration before promotion.

NON_GOALS: Everything until the ui.custom path is trustworthy; keyboard attach stays with xtrm-tui per the amendment.

CONSTRAINTS: TBD at promotion. Promotion requires re-reading current pi extension API behavior and the amendment.

VALIDATION: TBD at promotion; at minimum a flicker-free live inspector session plus unit coverage.

OUTPUT: TBD at promotion.

SCRUTINY: low
source.notes:
PROBLEM: The in-Pi Specialist inspector proved unreliable because ctx.ui.custom shares Pi's TUI renderer and can hard-lock or corrupt rendering under concurrent Fleet/session updates (unitAI-z49s2, unitAI-nmxhg). A text report is safe but insufficient for live Specialist inspection. Adapt the Herdr inspector concept to plain tmux: the useful part of Herdr is not Herdr-specific UI but separation of concerns -- agent runtime stays in place, inspector runs in its own real terminal pane, control talks back through a stable API. No child Pi process, no sp feed.

SUCCESS: /specialists inspect <activation> opens a stable live Specialist inspector without modifying, pausing, or replacing the coordinator Pi TUI. Inside tmux it opens in a dedicated pane (~40-45% width or lower pane, configurable): structured live transcript, runtime state, tool activity, pending asks, terminal result, plus explicitly requested control operations back to the same NativeActivationHost. Closing or crashing the inspector has no effect on the activation.

SCOPE:
- SpecialistInspectorProjection (live AgentSession transcript primary; snapshot/liveStats header; pending asks; ActivationResult; observability.db augmentation)
- Process-local Inspector API over NativeActivationHost over a tiny local IPC surface ($XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/xtrm/specialists/<coordinator-session-id>.sock; protocol: list, inspect, transcript [cursor], watch, reply, steer, resume, stop -- capability-limited, deliberately NOT the full host API: no dispatch, no lease/contract/capability changes)
- Standalone xtrm specialist inspect TUI client (own terminal; same pi-tui components; zero compositing with Pi renderer -- flicker/hard-lock disappears structurally)
- TmuxInspectorSurface (detect tmux, split-window, launch client, optional focus; outside tmux print the standalone command)
- /specialists inspect <activation> launcher
- Live/watch protocol, bounded cursor-based transcript rendering, structured Markdown/tool rendering, scroll/page/tool-detail/refresh/close controls, pending-ask display, explicit reply(m)/steer(a)/stop(s) input modes, reconnect behavior
- Herdr adapter compatibility seam (SpecialistInspectorSurface interface: Tmux v0 preferred, Herdr optional, XtrmTui future, InlinePi only if ui.custom proven)

NON_GOALS: No child Pi process; no sp feed; no screen scraping; no full Channels; no MCP server; no remote protocol; no tmux session manager (no ownership/server mgmt/auto-launch/persistence/discovery -- Herdr concerns, inspector is a view into an already-running activation); no AgentSession migration; no true child-chat attach; no xtrm-tui implementation; no ui.custom dependency.

CONSTRAINTS: NativeActivationHost remains authority; inspector is projection/client; one local IPC protocol for all renderers; inspector failure cannot affect activation; control uses existing runtime methods; transcript reads bounded/cursor-based; IPC local-only with restrictive permissions; no raw observability DB writes from inspector; observability is evidence, not control state.

VALIDATION: Running child continues while pane opens/closes; 20 repeated tmux open/close cycles; no coordinator TUI redraw/flicker; transcript follows live output; tool events render; waiting/needs_reply visible; answer resumes same child; settled result visible; inspector crash leaves activation untouched; coordinator shutdown terminates client cleanly; two simultaneous inspectors read-consistent; malformed/unauthorized socket client cannot mutate runtime.

OUTPUT: Shared InspectorProjection; local InspectorServer adapter; standalone inspector TUI; tmux launcher; /specialists inspect integration; Herdr/xtrm-tui adapter seam; tests + live tmux acceptance evidence.

SCRUTINY: medium
DEFERRED per operator 2026-09-09: full tmux-inspector design stands, unscheduled. Revisit when prioritized.
